title: PWM & Motor Physics
summary: Harness high-power inductors! Control motor speed with pulse width modulation and protect pins with flyback diodes.

steps.title: Inductive Coils & Magnetic Fields
steps.markdownContent: Motors and relays contain coils of wire that build magnetic fields. When power is suddenly cut, the collapsing field generates a high-voltage spike called **inductive kickback**!

steps.title: The Flyback Diode Protector
steps.markdownContent: A 1N4007 diode wired across the motor in reverse safely absorbs these 50V+ voltage spikes, protecting your Arduino's sensitive transistors from destruction.

steps.title: H-Bridge Drivers (L293D)
steps.markdownContent: Microcontroller pins can only supply 20mA. To spin high-current 500mA motors forward and backward, we command an **H-Bridge** driver chip like the L293D!

steps.title: Flyback Checkpoint
steps.markdownContent: Why do engineers install a flyback diode across DC motor and relay coils?

interactiveConfig.question: What is the purpose of a flyback diode?
options: To absorb high-voltage inductive kickback spikes when the coil shuts off
To make the motor spin backwards
To turn battery power into AC wall electricity
